text:
raj_partnerships: Quick heads-up — we have a hard cutoff today for the Azure Marketplace + NVIDIA co-marketing bundle. Need logo lockups, marketplace tile copy, and legal sign-off by EOD. Drive folder: https://drive.redwood/example/partners/azure-nvidia

lina_design: Uploaded logo pack v3 (SVG + 2x, 3x PNG). Variants: full-color, mono-white, mono-black. Notes in the file: use white mono on NVIDIA dark banners. Link: https://drive.redwood/example/partners/azure-nvidia/logos

maria_marketing: Thanks Lina. Can someone confirm the recommended hero headline? The marketplace tile currently says: "High-throughput LLM inference on Azure + NVIDIA A100s" — too clunky?

kevin_ae: I'd tighten to: "High-throughput LLM inference on Azure with NVIDIA GPUs" — shorter, action-y. Also we need a 150 char summary for the marketplace index.

olivia_azure: FYI Azure PMs prefer we lead with "Validated on Azure" language and include the Azure logo at the left of the tile — per their marketplace guide. I'll paste the marketplace logo rules in a sec.

olivia_azure: (shared) Marketplace guideline excerpt:
``
- Azure logo must be left aligned, 8px padding from tile edge
- Co-branding: partner logo to the right of Azure mark, not above
- Headline limit: 60 chars; Description: 150 chars
- No implied endorsement: avoid "by Azure" or similar
``

lina_design: Ok re: layout. I made two tile comps — `tile_A` (Azure left, Redwood + NVIDIA lockup right) and `tile_B` (Azure left, stacked Redwood over NVIDIA). Uploaded PNGs + source Sketch/FIG. Which works better for small screens?

maria_marketing: For small screens, `tile_A` is cleaner. Also we should A/B test the headline with short CTA. I'll draft two descriptions and drop them here.

maria_marketing: Option 1 (150 chars): "Run Redwood Inference on Azure with NVIDIA GPUs for predictable latency and cost—fully managed, SLA-ready deployments."

maria_marketing: Option 2 (150 chars): "Deploy high-throughput LLM inference on Azure with NVIDIA acceleration. Optimize latency and cost with Redwood’s unified runtime."

james_legal: Quick legal flag: check NVIDIA trademark usage rules — their brand requires spacing and prohibits color changes to the NVIDIA mark. Also we need a short IP clause on co-marketing assets. I can approve once we include the required trademark attribution line in the footer copy.

tony_nvidia: @james_legal happy to help — sending NVIDIA brand guidelines snippet. Short attribution to include: "NVIDIA and the NVIDIA logo are trademarks of NVIDIA Corporation." Also we request a pre-publish review of the final tile.

james_legal: Perfect. Add "NVIDIA and the NVIDIA logo are trademarks of NVIDIA Corporation. Used under license." and for Azure: "Microsoft and Azure are either registered trademarks or trademarks of the Microsoft Corporation in the United States and/or other countries."

raj_partnerships: Action list for EOD:
- Lina: finalize tile_A export for mobile + desktop (SVG + PNG 2x)
- Maria: pick final headline + 150-char desc (one of the two options)
- James: sign off on trademark lines and quick co-marketing clause (one paragraph)
- Olivia & Tony: final partner approvals (only final visual + attribution)
- Kevin: schedule go/no-go in calendar at 5pm PT

lina_design: On it — uploading final exports now. I added color hex notes: Redwood brand primary #0A6EFF, NVIDIA green #76B900, Azure blue #0078D4. Also included safe-zone PNGs.

maria_marketing: I'm leaning to Option 2. Slight copy tweak: replace "unified runtime" with "unified inference runtime" to be explicit. Final: "Deploy high-throughput LLM inference on Azure with NVIDIA acceleration. Optimize latency and cost with Redwood’s unified inference runtime."

james_legal: That copy looks fine. I approve the trademark lines and a short co-marketing clause: "Each party grants the other a non-exclusive, revocable, limited right to use its trademarks solely to promote the joint solution, subject to brand guidelines and prior approval of final artwork."

olivia_azure: Approved from Azure side pending final art. Please route final tile to marketplace@azure for checklist sync.

tony_nvidia: NVIDIA greenlighted pending the attribution line. I request a single flattened PNG with locked-up artwork for our records.

deploy-bot: deployment-checklist: marketplace tile size ok (<=2MB), includes required alt text, headline within limit.

kevin_ae: Meeting set for 5:00pm PT — I'll send an invite (30m). If all approvals are in by then we publish tomorrow morning. :thumbsup:

raj_partnerships: Thanks everyone — last ask: please add a one-paragraph case study blurb (max 3 sentences) for the solution brief folder so the partner pages can pull it. I'll collate and circulate to exec comms.

maria_marketing: Draft blurb: "Redwood Inference and NVIDIA on Azure deliver predictable, low-latency LLM inference for production applications. By combining Redwood’s optimized serving runtime with NVIDIA GPUs and Azure infrastructure, customers see improved throughput and lower per-token cost." Thoughts?

tony_nvidia: Good — suggest adding a customer outcome if we can (e.g., X% latency reduction). If we don't have a quant yet, keep as is.

kevin_ae: I'll check with the pilot customer for a quantitative stat; if we can't get it cleared by EOD, proceed without numbers.

lina_design: Final assets uploaded and named: `marketplace_tile_A_final.png`, `marketplace_tile_A_final@2x.png`, `lockup_flattened.png`, `brand_attrib.txt` (includes all trademark lines).

raj_partnerships: Awesome — linking final folder for approvals: https://drive.redwood/example/partners/azure-nvidia/final. Please drop an "approved" reply once you've reviewed so I can tick the checklist.

maria_marketing: approved

james_legal: approved

olivia_azure: approved (from Azure team)

tony_nvidia: approved (NVIDIA brand team)

kevin_ae: approved — see you at 5pm

raj_partnerships: Closing thread — thanks everyone. Will publish checklist + next steps in the meeting notes. :party_parrot:
